statements.statement: Business manager said level funding at two and a half percent over five years might yield about three new positions.
A member referred to a general override as a possible way to backfill ending ESSER revenue.

warnings.condition: absent another program replacing ESSER or an override
warnings.prediction: The district will be operating with fewer people in three years.
Budget outlook is likely worse than the last three years; cuts or budget fights may come.

warnings.condition: if funding stays at two and a half percent
warnings.prediction: With a two and a half percent increase the district cannot deliver all needed services.

warnings.condition: if ESSER-funded positions are not maintained
warnings.prediction: Social worker caseloads mean the district cannot meet needs if it returns to one social worker.
